recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-inlining: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.

recorded.prompt:q-inlining:b: Given the lesson page, this question and one of its wrong options: name the passage of the page that shows this option is wrong, or say that none does.
recorded.pass:q-inlining:b: an independent Q3 reader agent, separate from the author (M9-7 S2)
recorded.outcome:q-inlining:b: Pitfall 4 says performance overhead is 'Rarely a real concern: the JIT compiler inlines trivial getters and setters, so they cost the same as direct field access in hot code', contradicting both the per-call cost and the advice to read the field.
recorded.prompt:q-inlining:c: Given the lesson page, this question and one of its wrong options: name the passage of the page that shows this option is wrong, or say that none does.
recorded.pass:q-inlining:c: an independent Q3 reader agent, separate from the author (M9-7 S2)
recorded.outcome:q-inlining:c: A4 says only a reference is copied for an object ('the reference is copied, and the copy still points to the same object') and that 'returning a primitive or a reference costs the same; only a getter that builds a defensive copy pays for creating that copy'.
recorded.prompt:q-redundant:a: Given the lesson page, this question and one of its wrong options: name the passage of the page that shows this option is wrong, or say that none does.
recorded.pass:q-redundant:a: an independent Q3 reader agent, separate from the author (M9-7 S2)
recorded.outcome:q-redundant:a: Key Point 4 endorses this naming: 'getters start with "get" (or "is" for boolean)', and the pitfalls list never cautions against it.
recorded.prompt:q-redundant:b: Given the lesson page, this question and one of its wrong options: name the passage of the page that shows this option is wrong, or say that none does.
recorded.pass:q-redundant:b: an independent Q3 reader agent, separate from the author (M9-7 S2)
recorded.outcome:q-redundant:b: Pitfall 2 cautions against the opposite, 'Lack of validation in setters: Always validate input in setters to maintain object integrity'.
